requirements.summary: Wrap the root application component tree with MemberAuthProvider from 'frontend/src/hooks/useMemberAuth.tsx' so that member authentication context is available to all pages and components
acceptanceCriteria: MemberAuthProvider wraps the entire component tree rendered by App.tsx
The useMemberAuth hook resolves correctly (no 'used outside provider' errors) in Login, MemberDashboard, and Navigation components
All existing routes continue to render without errors
Member login and logout flows work as before

file_operations.description: Import MemberAuthProvider from './hooks/useMemberAuth.tsx' and wrap the RouterProvider component (or the entire JSX tree returned by the App function) with <MemberAuthProvider>. Ensure the provider wraps all routing logic so that all child routes and components have access to the member authentication context. Do not modify frontend/src/main.tsx as it is immutable.
